title: Efficient and stable inverted MA/Br-free 2D/3D perovskite solar cells enabled by α-to-δ phase transition inhibition and crystallization modulation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04136D, Paper
Zhiyuan Xu, Zhihao Guo, Haiyun Li, Yuqin Zhou, Zhenyu Liu, Ke Wang, Zhijun Li, Huaxin Wang, Saif M. H. Qaid, Omar F. Mohammed, Zhigang Zang
An FA-based organic derivative, namely BLSCl, has been explored as a spacer for MA/Br-free FA-based 2D/3D perovskites. A champion efficiency of 25.96% for the 0.1 cm2 device and 24.54% (certified 23.94%) for the 1.01 cm2 device have been achieved.
